acceptanceCriteria: bun provider runs live in a qualified CI or recorded Linux environment with receipt retained.
Example-level selection by file:line works for bun suites with a fixture test.
body: V1-2191 (PR #1413, GH #1405) added corvint-js-test-provider bun, live-qualified only on one Mac (bun 1.3.11). Missing: a CI live qualification lane and file:line example-level selection parity with vitest.
title: bun test provider: live CI qualification and file:line example selection
